limitations: Instrumented diagnostic hosts are separate from primary timing binaries; no elapsed speedup is inferred from this cohort.
Count completion is an in-task boundary; body completion is before OS thread-wrapper exit.
Rust workers return maps and format/drop them in main; Mech workers include publication and generated body work.
Per-core counters are read-only and cumulative. Performance/Efficiency names and 125/3 ns Mach timebase were verified on this runner.
Preparation spans are nested and instrumented; do not add them or substitute them for primary elapsed samples. Worker and preparation roots use separate clock origins.

Candidate has three additional phase slots with the same clock/aggregation implementation; controls keep their seven-slot probes. Source-loan, combined transform/copy and chunk-receipt spans replace the unused legacy copy/map spans. Their scopes and clock counts differ, and no clock-overhead subtraction is made.

candidate.source_loan: retained source chunk acquisition, geometry and output loan metadata
candidate.joined_transform: generated direct source transform/copy interval including its native return boundary
candidate.chunk_receipt: host initialization/geometry/allocation receipt validation and source-owner retirement
candidate.map_finish: final UTF-8/private-owner handoff and original logical map finish

parent.join_copy: physical append of selected source chunk into destination
parent.map_kernel: existing emitted mapper over initialized destination chunks
parent.map_finish: final UTF-8/private-owner handoff and original logical map finish
